node.build: Official 11.2.0 Linux amd64 release asset; SHA256 8b287e300ffb2063522fc33d50da6ecee8fa10fc7445c906fae0ca9783db8e03 (GitHub marks this tag as a prerelease).

run.cli: cardano-cli 11.6.0.0 from the same release archive
setup: One stake pool, three DReps, no constitutional committee, testnet magic 42, 200-slot epochs of 0.1 s, generated with cardano-testnet create-env.

ExperimentalHardForksEnabled and TestDijkstraHardForkAtEpoch 2 in the generated versioned configuration. The epoch trigger changes the era but initially leaves protocol version 10. Two governance actions raised it to 11 then 12.

The recorded transaction matrix ran after checking protocol version 12. It now has 25 encodings: the 9 signed envelopes and 8 mempool encodings of the earlier matrix, plus a direct deposit, a top-level transaction carrying a signed sub-transaction and an output holding a PlutusV4 reference script (advanced.sh), with their split and mempool encodings. The 11.2.0 CLI has no options for guards or balance intervals, so those stay unexercised.

Ogmios and Kupo first rejected the versioned configuration envelope. Their subsequent protocol checks use an equivalent flattened legacy configuration. db-sync also needs Protocol and LastKnownBlockVersion fields plus a Shelley genesis copy rounded to Byron whole-second startTime (under one second difference).

Only what ran on 2026-11-09 is recorded; nothing is carried over from 2026-11-01, whose results stay in the archived assessment. Version labels name exactly what ran: current releases and release candidates, Pallas main, and txtop's latest release with its gouroboros pin raised. Historical patched controls were not rerun.
Raw logs, fixtures, resolved build inputs and checksums are retained under content/readiness/dijkstra-runs/2026-11-09/. No signing keys or credentials are retained.

Not run: Koios (its Dijkstra branch reads the db-sync tables, and db-sync stops before the advanced transactions), guards and balance intervals (no CLI support), executing a PlutusV4 script, and the versioned-configuration check for Ogmios and Kupo. Pass means only the capability and cases named by that check.
